entries.title: Identifiability of car-following dynamics
method_extracted: Definitions 1-2: structural global and structural local identifiability of the parameter vector given initial conditions and admissible inputs
structural analysis by a differential geometry approach; practical analysis by an optimisation-based numerical direct test for a specific experimental setup

result: all tested systems are structurally locally identifiable, but CTH-RV and FTL are not identifiable for a specific setup, and with measurement error present all models are not practically identifiable
